claims.claim: Bought as brand new working perfectly well
claims.evidence: Witness report notes the fan appears intact with no obvious broken grille wires, but does not confirm operation, motor noise, speed control, oscillation, or power/rating.

risks.risk: Not actually working (motor/bearing failure, intermittent power, or blade imbalance) despite appearing intact
risks.proof: A short video clip of the fan switched ON showing airflow, stable rotation, and no unusual noise/vibration at low and high speed.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst-case: needs repair/servicing).

risks.risk: Speed control may not work (panel/label unreadable; function not tested)
risks.proof: Close-up + clip showing speed changes on the control panel (or knob/buttons) with corresponding RPM/airflow change.
risks.if_unproven: Price as limited/unknown speed control (worst-case: only one speed).

risks.risk: Oscillation/tilt function may be missing or non-functional
risks.proof: Clip showing oscillation/tilt movement (side-to-side or up/down) when activated.
risks.if_unproven: Price as no oscillation (worst-case: fixed position only).

risks.risk: Electrical safety issues (wiring damage, capacitor/burn marks, loose connections) not visible from angles
risks.proof: Photo of the plug and cable condition plus a clip of operation with no sparking/overheating; ideally a quick inspection of any visible wiring/terminal area.
risks.if_unproven: Price with safety risk allowance (worst-case: needs electrical check).

risks.risk: Missing accessories or incorrect parts (remote/manual, stand components, screws/guards) not shown
risks.proof: Photo inventory of all included items: remote/manual (if any), base/stand parts, screws, and any control accessories.
risks.if_unproven: Price as fan only (worst-case: missing accessories).

risks.risk: Unknown power rating/compatibility (voltage/watts not readable) affecting value
risks.proof: Clear photo of rating plate/label showing voltage (e.g., 220–240V) and wattage.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic/unknown rating (worst-case: may not match local supply).

proof_requests: Clear photo of the rating plate/label on the center hub or motor housing showing brand/model and voltage/watts.
Video of the fan running: ON/OFF, low-to-high speed changes, and stable rotation without wobble or unusual noise.
Video showing oscillation/tilt (if it has it) when activated.
Photo of the plug and full visible cable condition (no cuts/burn marks).
Photos of any accessories included (remote/manual) and confirmation of what’s in the box.
response.reason: The witness can identify it as a standing electric fan and reports it appears intact, so it can be priced at its worst-case as unverified working. However, key operating and electrical checks are not shown, so the price should reflect that uncertainty.
